caption: ZeroSOC
name: zerosoc
description: The ZeroSOC Framework's attributes of a Case, of an Observation of a Case, or of a ticket a Case raised. Each attribute applies to one of them, as its description says; the framework's Case Schema says which are required where.

candidate_incident_categories.description: On a Case: the incident categories the Case's alert types propose, each an IC-## identifier of the framework's incident categories.

incident_category.description: On a Case: the Case's incident category, an IC-## identifier of the framework's incident categories. Provisional until the Case is an Incident.

reclassification_pivots.description: On a Case: each change of the Case's candidate incident category, with the evidence that triggered it.

entry_path.description: On a Case: how the Case entered the loop: alert, hunt or out-of-band. A hunt or out-of-band Case is a detection false negative by construction.

visibility_gaps.description: On a Case: the required data sources that were not available, each with the check it prevented.

provenance.description: On a Case: the playbooks the Case was handled under, the classes of executor that handled it, the capability classes they invoked and the products whose records it was built from.

significant.description: On a Case: whether the incident is significant under the NIS2 Directive's test: severe operational disruption or financial loss, or considerable damage to other persons.

cross_border.description: On a Case: whether the incident has a cross-border effect.

notifications.description: On a Case: the stakeholder and regulatory notifications the Case requires, and their deadlines.

handover_reason.description: On a Case: why the Case's assignee became a person: crown-jewel, privileged-identity or manual.

watch_until.description: On a Case: until when the Case's entities are watched after an Insufficient Data or Low-confidence close.

master_case_uid.description: On a Case: on a Case closed as a Duplicate, the open master Case that handles the activity, by the identifier its metadata.correlation_uid holds.

side.description: On an Observation: the hypothesis it bears on, Malicious or Benign. Absent where the Observation is context.

confidence_id.description: On an Observation with a side: how far it bears on that hypothesis, Low (1), Medium (2) or High (3).

timeline.description: On an Observation: whether the Case Timeline renders it.

alert_type.description: On an Alert: the framework's alert type it is triaged under, the one its source declares or the one the executor identifies.

kind.description: On a ticket: what it is for, which the ticket's type does not say, such as tuning, visibility, containment, eradication, recovery or exception.
